questions.question: Solve 2 sin 2θ = sqrt3 cos θ for 0 <= θ < 2pi

points.text: 2(2 sin θ cos θ) = sqrt3 cos θ -> cos θ(4 sin θ - sqrt3) = 0. cos θ = 0 -> θ = pi/2, 3pi/2. sin θ = sqrt3/4 ≈ 0.433 -> θ ≈ 0.448, 2.694
